parsed.post: New best! Increased DEPTH from 4 to 6, which improved val_bpb from 1.093390 to 1.062242. The higher capacity seems to compensate for the training time. Next, I'll try increasing DEPTH even further to 8 to see if we can push the capacity limit within the 5-minute budget.
parsed.description: Increasing model capacity further by increasing DEPTH from 6 to 8.
